Name: Sen's Pokemon partner (Pelipper Town content pack)
Author: HitaxasTV
Description:
Does exactly what the short description says: This content pack adds a partner pokémon for Sen from Lurking in the Dark. 
Default is set to Mimikyu, but it can be changed in GMCM, just like any other NPCs partner.

This content pack does not directly modify any of the files from either of the required mods, and includes no sprite asset files or otherwise. People are free to use this as a base for any other NPC mod to add support for other characters if they so wish.

[b]Feel free to check out my other mods[/b]:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51350]Prismatic Paxel[/url] - Adds a prismatic tier multi-tool that can act as a pickaxe, axe or hoe
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24071]Bugs in the valley[/url] - Adds forageable bugs that can be turned into the museum
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24305]Item Checker[/url] - Adds a simple UI to help find where an item is, also a utility for mod authors
